title: Countries and nationalities
about: The seven continents, the names of many countries, and the words for people and things from those countries, like Italy – Italian and Japan – Japanese.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Назви континентів, країн, національностей і мов англійською завжди пишуться з великої літери: Africa, Italy, Italian, English — навіть усередині речення (an English lesson). Деякі країни мають the: the USA, the UK. Про національність кажуть прикметником без a: She's Spanish, а не She's a Spanish. Своєї країни в списку немає? Україна — Ukraine (без the), українець / українка, українська мова — Ukrainian.

parts.title: Tip
parts.note: Прикметники національності найчастіше закінчуються на -(i)an (Italian, Brazilian), -ish (Polish, Spanish) або -ese (Chinese, Japanese). Винятки — Pakistani, Thai, French. Назва мови часто така сама, як прикметник: French, Spanish, Japanese, Thai. Виняток — Arabic: у Єгипті, Марокко й Тунісі говорять арабською. А в Бразилії говорять португальською, в Аргентині, Чилі, Колумбії та Перу — іспанською.

items.pattern: a continent · seven continents · on a continent
items.meaning: one of the seven very big areas of land on Earth, like Africa or Asia
items.example: Which **continent** do you want to visit first?
more: How many **continents** have you been to?
Africa is a **continent**, not a country.
items.watchOut: Материк — continent, а не mainland. Mainland — це «материкова частина» країни на відміну від островів. Наголос на першому складі: /ˈkɒntɪnənt/.

items.pattern: in North America
items.meaning: the continent with Canada, the USA and Mexico
items.example: We flew across the ocean to **North America**.
more: Big brown bears live in the forests of **North America**.
My uncle drove across **North America** in a small car.
items.watchOut: Без the: in North America. Словом America часто називають США.

items.pattern: in South America
items.meaning: the continent with Brazil, Argentina, Peru and other countries
items.example: Brazil is the biggest country in **South America**.
more: Lots of people in **South America** speak Spanish.
My aunt wants to travel around **South America** next year.
items.watchOut: Без the: in South America, а не in the South America.

items.pattern: in Europe · European (adjective)
items.meaning: the continent with Ukraine, Poland, Spain, Italy and many other countries
items.example: My dad travelled around **Europe** by train.
more: Many people in **Europe** spend their summer holidays by the sea.
Our school trip went to three countries in **Europe**.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈjʊərəp/ — приблизно «Юероп», а не «Европа». Європейський — European /ˌjʊərəˈpiːən/.

items.pattern: in Asia · Asian (adjective)
items.meaning: the biggest continent, with China, India, Japan and many other countries
items.example: Tokyo is one of the biggest cities in **Asia**.
more: My aunt is travelling around **Asia** this summer.
Lots of people in **Asia** eat rice every day.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈeɪʒə/ — «Ейжа», а не «Азія».

items.pattern: in Africa · African (adjective)
items.meaning: the big hot continent with Egypt, Morocco, South Africa and many other countries
items.example: Lions and elephants live in **Africa**.
more: We saw a film about a school in **Africa**.
The Nile, in **Africa**, is one of the longest rivers in the world.
items.watchOut: Завжди з великої літери: Africa, а не africa. Африканський — African.

items.pattern: in Australia · also called Australasia or Oceania
items.meaning: the smallest continent: Australia, New Zealand and many islands
items.example: It's summer in **Australia** when it's winter in Ukraine.
more: The continent of **Australia** has deserts, beaches and rainforests.
Lots of people fly from Europe to **Australia** for a long holiday.
items.watchOut: Australia — і країна, і континент. Вимова /ɒˈstreɪliə/ — «Острейлія».

items.pattern: in Antarctica · the Antarctic
items.meaning: the very cold continent around the South Pole, covered in ice
items.example: Scientists from many countries work in **Antarctica**.
more: Penguins and seals live in **Antarctica**.
It's very windy in **Antarctica**.
items.watchOut: Антарктида — Antarctica, з -ica в кінці, а не Antarctida. The Antarctic — область навколо Південного полюса.

items.pattern: in the USA · an American city · She's American.
items.meaning: the USA: a big country in North America. American: from the USA
items.example: New York is the biggest city in **the USA**.
more: My favourite singer is **American**.
Have you ever been to **the US**?
items.watchOut: США завжди з the: in the USA, to the US. Ще кажуть the States або просто America.

items.pattern: in Argentina · Argentinian football · He's Argentinian.
items.meaning: Argentina: a country in South America. Argentinian: from Argentina
items.example: My pen friend lives in **Argentina**.
more: We watched an **Argentinian** film at school.
My uncle loves **Argentinian** football.
items.watchOut: Ще можна сказати Argentine, але Argentinian простіше. В Аргентині говорять іспанською (Spanish).

items.pattern: in Australia · Australian animals · She's Australian.
items.meaning: Australia: a big country that is also a continent. Australian: from Australia
items.example: My uncle works in **Australia** as a teacher.
more: Kangaroos are **Australian** animals.
Our new swimming coach is **Australian**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: Australian /ɒˈstreɪliən/ — «острейліен».

items.pattern: in Brazil · Brazilian music · He's Brazilian.
items.meaning: Brazil: the biggest country in South America. Brazilian: from Brazil
items.example: **Brazilian** footballers are famous all over the world.
more: We watched a dance show from **Brazil**.
My friend has a **Brazilian** grandmother.
items.watchOut: Пишеться із z: Brazil. У Бразилії говорять португальською (Portuguese) — «бразильської» мови немає.

items.pattern: in Canada · a Canadian team · She's Canadian.
items.meaning: Canada: a big cold country in North America. Canadian: from Canada
items.example: It's very cold in **Canada** in winter.
more: Our hockey team played against a **Canadian** team.
My aunt moved to **Canada** five years ago.
items.watchOut: Наголос змінюється: Canada /ˈkænədə/ — на першому складі, Canadian /kəˈneɪdiən/ — на другому.

items.pattern: in Colombia · Colombian coffee · He's Colombian.
items.meaning: Colombia: a country in the north of South America. Colombian: from Colombia
items.example: My mum loves **Colombian** coffee.
more: We met a **Colombian** family on holiday.
It's warm in **Colombia** all year.
items.watchOut: Пишеться Colombia — з o в другому складі, а не Columbia.

items.pattern: in Egypt · Egyptian history · She's Egyptian.
items.meaning: Egypt: a country in the north of Africa. Egyptian: from Egypt
items.example: We went to **Egypt** in winter and swam in the warm sea.
more: The museum has an old **Egyptian** boat.
It's very hot in **Egypt** in summer.
items.watchOut: Вимова: Egypt /ˈiːdʒɪpt/ — «Іджипт», Egyptian /iˈdʒɪpʃn/ — «іджипшн». У Єгипті говорять арабською (Arabic).

items.pattern: in Germany · German bread · He's German. · speak German
items.meaning: Germany: a country in the middle of Europe. German: from Germany; also its language
items.uk: Німеччина; німецький, німець / німкеня; німецька мова
items.example: We drove through **Germany** on the way to France.
more: My piano teacher is **German**.
My dad likes dark **German** bread.
items.watchOut: Німецький — German, без -ian у кінці: не Germanian. Не плутай Germany і German.

items.pattern: in India · Indian food · She's Indian.
items.meaning: India: a very big country in Asia. Indian: from India
items.example: We often cook **Indian** food at home.
more: Elephants live in **India** too.
My friend wore a beautiful **Indian** dress at the party.
items.watchOut: Indian — і «індійський», і «індіанець». Про корінних жителів Америки зараз частіше кажуть Native Americans.

items.pattern: in Italy · Italian food · He's Italian. · speak Italian
items.meaning: Italy: a country in the south of Europe. Italian: from Italy; also its language
items.uk: Італія; італійський, італієць / італійка; італійська мова
items.example: We had a lovely holiday in **Italy** last summer.
more: My favourite ice cream is **Italian**.
Our neighbours are **Italian**, and they speak Italian at home.
items.watchOut: Наголос: Italy /ˈɪtəli/ — на першому складі, Italian /ɪˈtæliən/ — на другому.

items.pattern: in Morocco · Moroccan food · She's Moroccan.
items.meaning: Morocco: a country in the north-west of Africa. Moroccan: from Morocco
items.example: We bought a colourful carpet in **Morocco**.
more: **Moroccan** food has lots of spices.
My friend's family is **Moroccan**.
items.watchOut: Два c і одне r: Morocco, Moroccan. Наголос на другому складі: /məˈrɒkəʊ/.

items.pattern: in Peru · Peruvian music · He's Peruvian.
items.meaning: Peru: a country in South America with high mountains. Peruvian: from Peru
items.example: My uncle climbed the mountains in **Peru**.
more: We listened to **Peruvian** music at the festival.
My cousin sent me a warm hat from **Peru**.
items.watchOut: У прикметнику з'являється v: Peru — Peruvian /pəˈruːviən/.

items.pattern: in South Africa · a South African team · She's South African.
items.meaning: South Africa: a country at the very south of Africa. South African: from South Africa
items.example: My cousin saw lions and zebras on holiday in **South Africa**.
more: Our school team played against a **South African** team.
My mum has a **South African** friend who loves cooking.
items.watchOut: South Africa — це одна країна. Africa — увесь континент.

items.pattern: in Tunisia · Tunisian food · He's Tunisian.
items.meaning: Tunisia: a small country in the north of Africa. Tunisian: from Tunisia
items.example: Lots of tourists go to **Tunisia** for the beaches.
more: She has a **Tunisian** dad and a French mum.
We ate **Tunisian** food at a small café.
items.watchOut: Країна — Tunisia, а її столиця — Tunis. Українською обидва — Туніс.

items.pattern: in Chile · Chilean children · She's Chilean.
items.meaning: Chile: a long, thin country in South America. Chilean: from Chile
items.example: We watched a film about the deserts and mountains of **Chile**.
more: **Chilean** children have their summer holidays in January.
My pen friend is **Chilean**.
items.watchOut: Вимова Chile /ˈtʃɪli/ — «Чилі», як chilli (гострий перець). Прикметник — Chilean.

items.pattern: in the UK · British people · He's British.
items.meaning: the UK: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland together. British: from the UK
items.uk: Велика Британія (Сполучене Королівство); британський, британець / британка
items.example: My cousin studies in **the UK**.
more: **British** people often talk about the weather.
Do you like **British** music?
items.watchOut: Завжди з the: in the UK. British — про всю країну, English — тільки про Англію. Людина із Шотландії скаже I'm Scottish або I'm British, але не I'm English.

items.pattern: in England · English food · She's English. · speak English
items.meaning: England: the biggest part of the UK. English: from England; also the language
items.uk: Англія; англійський, англієць / англійка; англійська мова
items.example: We visited **England** and saw lots of old castles.
more: Our new neighbours are **English**. They come from Manchester.
Everyone in our class speaks a little **English**.
items.watchOut: England — тільки Англія, частина UK. Англієць — He's English (або an Englishman), але не an English.

items.pattern: in Finland · a Finnish sauna · He's Finnish.
items.meaning: Finland: a cold country in the north of Europe. Finnish: from Finland; also its language
items.uk: Фінляндія; фінський, фін / фінка; фінська мова
items.example: It snows a lot in **Finland** in winter.
more: Do you know any **Finnish** words?
My dad has a **Finnish** friend from work.
items.watchOut: Finnish — з двома n. Не плутай з finish (закінчувати), де одна n.

items.pattern: in Ireland · Irish music · She's Irish.
items.meaning: Ireland: an island country west of the UK. Irish: from Ireland
items.example: **Ireland** is very green because it rains a lot.
more: We danced to **Irish** music at the school party.
My best friend's mum is **Irish**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: Ireland /ˈaɪələnd/ — «Айеленд», Irish /ˈaɪrɪʃ/ — «айриш».

items.pattern: in Poland · Polish food · He's Polish. · speak Polish
items.meaning: Poland: a country in Europe, next to Ukraine. Polish: from Poland; also its language
items.uk: Польща; польський, поляк / полька; польська мова
items.example: We took the bus from Lviv to **Poland**.
more: My aunt is **Polish**, and she makes great soup.
Do you understand **Polish**?
items.watchOut: Polish /ˈpəʊlɪʃ/ (польський) і polish /ˈpɒlɪʃ/ (полірувати) пишуться однаково, але звучать по-різному. Польський — завжди з великої P.

items.pattern: in Scotland · Scottish music · She's Scottish.
items.meaning: Scotland: the part of the UK in the north. Scottish: from Scotland
items.example: We went walking in the mountains in **Scotland**.
more: Our tour guide in Glasgow was **Scottish**.
My grandad loves old **Scottish** songs.
items.watchOut: Про людей і речі кажуть Scottish. Scotch — тільки в кількох назвах продуктів; про людину так зазвичай не кажуть.

items.pattern: in Spain · Spanish food · She's Spanish. · speak Spanish
items.meaning: Spain: a sunny country in the south-west of Europe. Spanish: from Spain; also its language
items.uk: Іспанія; іспанський, іспанець / іспанка; іспанська мова
items.example: We spent two weeks on the beach in **Spain**.
more: I'm learning **Spanish** because I want to visit Madrid.
**Spanish** children often go to bed late in summer.
items.watchOut: Іспанець — He's Spanish, без a. Не Spainish і не Spanian.

items.pattern: in China · Chinese food · He's Chinese. · speak Chinese
items.meaning: China: a very big country in Asia. Chinese: from China; also its language
items.uk: Китай; китайський, китаєць / китаянка; китайська мова
items.example: My little sister loves **Chinese** noodles.
more: We celebrated **Chinese** New Year at school.
My dad went to **China** for work.
items.watchOut: Китайська їжа — Chinese food, а не China food. Наголос: Chinese /ˌtʃaɪˈniːz/ — на останньому складі.

items.pattern: in Japan · Japanese food · She's Japanese. · speak Japanese
items.meaning: Japan: an island country in Asia. Japanese: from Japan; also its language
items.uk: Японія; японський, японець / японка; японська мова
items.example: Our school has a **Japanese** student this year.
more: We want to visit **Japan** in spring to see the trees in flower.
My brother draws **Japanese** comics.
items.watchOut: Наголос: Japan /dʒəˈpæn/ — на другому складі, Japanese /ˌdʒæpəˈniːz/ — на останньому.

items.pattern: in Portugal · Portuguese cakes · He's Portuguese. · speak Portuguese
items.meaning: Portugal: a country in Europe, next to Spain. Portuguese: from Portugal; also its language
items.uk: Португалія; португальський, португалець / португалка; португальська мова
items.example: **Portugal** is next to Spain.
more: My friend speaks **Portuguese** because she lived in Lisbon.
We ate **Portuguese** cakes at the market.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˌpɔːtʃʊˈɡiːz/ — приблизно «почугіз»: u після g не читається. Португальською говорять і в Португалії, і в Бразилії.

items.pattern: in Pakistan · Pakistani food · He's Pakistani.
items.meaning: Pakistan: a big country in Asia, next to India. Pakistani: from Pakistan
items.example: My classmate's family is **Pakistani**.
more: **Pakistan** is next to India.
Cricket is very popular in **Pakistan**.
items.watchOut: Пакистанський — Pakistani, з -i в кінці. Не Pakistanian.

items.pattern: in Thailand · Thai food · She's Thai. · speak Thai
items.meaning: Thailand: a warm country in Asia. Thai: from Thailand; also its language
items.uk: Таїланд; тайський, таєць / тайка; тайська мова
items.example: We had a holiday on a beautiful island in **Thailand**.
more: Do you like **Thai** food? It's quite spicy.
Our neighbour is **Thai**, and she teaches us to cook.
items.watchOut: Th тут читається як т: Thai /taɪ/, Thailand /ˈtaɪlænd/. Прикметник — Thai, не Thailandish.

items.pattern: in France · French bread · He's French. · speak French
items.meaning: France: a big country in the west of Europe. French: from France; also its language
items.uk: Франція; французький, француз / француженка; французька мова
items.example: We took the train from London to **France**.
more: I love **French** bread.
My sister is learning **French** at school.
items.watchOut: Француз — He's French (або a Frenchman), а не a French. Мова — теж French, без the.

items.pattern: in New Zealand · a New Zealander · New Zealand food
items.meaning: New Zealand: an island country near Australia. A New Zealander: a person from New Zealand
items.example: **New Zealand** is near Australia, but it's a different country.
more: Our swimming teacher is a **New Zealander**.
They made a famous fantasy film in **New Zealand**.
items.watchOut: Прикметник — просто New Zealand: New Zealand food. Людина — a New Zealander, розмовно a Kiwi.

warmup.explain: Про національність кажуть прикметником без a: He's English. Можна an Englishman, але не an English.
США — the USA або the US, завжди з the. America без the.

warmup.uk: Моя тітка живе у Великій Британії.
warmup.explain: The UK — з the. Britain і Great Britain — без the.
Мова — French, без the. France — це країна.
Іспанка — She's Spanish, прикметник без a.
Бразильської мови немає: у Бразилії говорять португальською — Portuguese.

warmup.uk: Австралія — це і країна, і материк.
warmup.q: Australia is a country and a ___.
warmup.explain: Материк — continent. Mainland — материкова частина країни (не острови).
Пакистанський, пакистанець — Pakistani, з -i в кінці.

A.explain: Європа, Азія й Африка — континенти, continents.

A.q: There are no cities in ___. It's all ice and snow.
A.explain: Антарктида — Antarctica: там лише лід і сніг.

A.q: Chile is a long country in ___.
A.explain: Чилі — у Південній Америці, South America.

B.q: My friend is from Poland. She's ___.

B.explain: Таїланд — Thailand, тайці й тайський — Thai.

B.q: My cousin is learning ___ because she wants to live in Tokyo.
B.explain: Токіо — у Японії, тож вона вчить японську — Japanese.

example.title: International Day
example.uk:
Сьогодні в нашій школі був Міжнародний день. Кожен клас вибрав країну.

Наш клас вибрав Італію. Ми робили піцу й слухали італійські пісні. Клас 6-Б вибрав Японію, що в Азії. Вони робили японських паперових пташок.

Мама моєї подруги Олени — полька, тож вона навчила нас кількох польських слів. Потім учитель із Великої Британії розповів нам про Шотландію.

Наприкінці ми подивилися на велику карту й знайшли кожен континент. Мені найбільше сподобалася Антарктида, але там надто холодно для шкільної екскурсії!

Today was International Day at our school. Every class chose a country.

Our class chose [[Italy|b10]]. We made pizza and listened to [[Italian|b10]] songs. Class 6B chose [[Japan|b24]], in [[Asia|a5]]. They made [[Japanese|b24]] paper birds.

My friend Olena's mum is [[Polish|b20]], so she taught us some Polish words. Then a teacher from [[the UK|b16]] told us about [[Scotland|b21]].

At the end, we looked at a big map and found every [[continent|a1]]. My favourite was [[Antarctica|a8]], but it's too cold for a school trip!
